key_highlights: ASX mixed: tech and miners led gains post Wall Street surge (Nasdaq +2% record), while oil stocks struggled before snapping losing run
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand amid RBA rate hike pressure on household spending
Saudi oil shock sent Australian fuel prices surging; diesel supply down 8% creating logistics cost pressure
Gold miners active: Critical Resources surged on Suriname grab, Aurum raised $52.5M, Platina secured Rio cheque, Dalaroo advancing Côte d'Ivoire project
CGT and negative gearing reform study shows net tax reduction for many investors, supporting property and equity sentiment
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees; Qantas confirms Sydney-New York non-stop timing
Federal/state governments face debt cliff; former treasurer warns economic reform requires 'financial crisis' catalyst
NAB experienced online/phone banking outage, resolved; operational risk flag for financials sector

sectors.trend: Miners rose on ASX; gold exploration names active (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill demerger). Rare earths (Jupiter/Critica) gaining offtake traction. China rebalancing towards robots supports structural demand for critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Gold and rare earths sub-sectors offer relative strength. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from broad miner bid. Small-cap gold explorers show elevated risk/reward but liquidity risk remains.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks initially struggled on falling crude but snapped losing run. Saudi oil shock spiked Australian fuel prices. Diesel supply down 8%. OPEC+ silence (Riyadh/Moscow) creates uncertainty. Trump mulls diesel nuclear option.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face volatile pricing. Fuel cost surge pressures transport and consumer sectors. OPEC+ inaction is a two-way risk for LNG and oil names.

sectors.trend: Tech led ASX higher following Nasdaq 2% surge to record. Meta +11% on AI/Muse downloads. $16B Aussie tech firm in China-link controversy. Data centres straining net-zero targets. AXT Inc +16% on S&P 600 inclusion.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (XRO.AX, W1.AX, SVL.AX) benefits from global AI momentum. China-linked tech faces regulatory/reputational risk. Data centre build-out supports power demand but creates ESG headwinds.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending. NAB outage (resolved) flags operational risk. Debt cliff for governments pressures sovereign credit. CGT/negative gearing reform reduces investor tax burden.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face credit cycle risk. NAB.AX outage is a minor operational flag. Government debt trajectory pressures bond yields and bank funding costs.

sectors.trend: Myer jumped on ASX. Jetstar industrial action (fee waivers) pressures Qantas Group margins. Fuel cost surge hits household budgets. Flash PMI softening signals demand weakness. El Niño threatens agricultural output.
sectors.implications: MYR.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. QAN.AX/JLH.AX industrial action is a near-term earnings risk. Consumer staples defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Syngenis launched precision medicine venture. Guardant Health (US) in focus on AI oncology. CSL remains key ASX healthcare anchor.
sectors.implications: SYG.AX gains strategic optionality. CSL.AX benefits from global healthcare demand. AI-driven diagnostics is a structural tailwind.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand pushing property prices lower. CGT/negative gearing reform reduces tax for many investors. Chinese property recovery question mark. Satterley Perth Hills estate plan rejected.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, SPG.AX) face supply/demand imbalance. Tax reform is net positive for investor sentiment. China property recovery would support iron ore demand indirectly.

key_themes: RBA tightening cycle pressuring household spending and PMI
Oil/fuel volatility from Saudi shock and OPEC+ inaction
Gold and rare earths exploration activity accelerating
AI/tech momentum from US spilling into ASX
CGT/negative gearing reform reducing investor tax burden

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike cycle squeezing household demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX); underweight rate-sensitive REITs and discretionary consumer

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price surge and diesel supply shortfall (8% down)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport/logistics exposure; monitor WDS.AX, WLE.AX for margin compression

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Government debt cliff and fiscal sustainability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor 10-year bond yields; reduce sovereign-linked credit exposure; favour cash-generative equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: OPEC+ inaction and oil price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify energy exposure across oil, gas, and renewables; avoid concentrated single-commodity bets
Reduce QAN.AX/JLH.AX exposure until resolution; monitor for earnings revision risk
Monitor SUG.AX, TNL.AX, W1.AX for crop yield impacts; consider weather-derivative hedges
Assess ASX tech names with China revenue exposure; favour domestic-focused tech

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths explorers on active project pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple catalysts: Critical Resources Suriname grab, Aurum $52.5M raise, Platina Rio cheque, Dalaroo assays, Jupiter/Critica offtake. Gold benefits from geopolitical uncertainty and OPEC+ inaction.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long ASX tech on US AI momentum spillover
opportunities.rationale: Nasdaq record high, Meta +11%, global chip rally. ASX tech lags US peers, offering catch-up potential. Data centre build-out supports structural demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Benefit from CGT/negative gearing tax reform in property equities
opportunities.rationale: Study shows net tax reduction for many investors, supporting REIT and property developer sentiment despite supply/demand imbalance.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to rate-sensitive and fuel-cost-pressured names
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening + fuel surge + soft PMI create headwinds for discretionary consumer, transport, and high-yield REITs.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation ahead of fiscal uncertainty
defensive_moves.rationale: Government debt cliff and former treasurer's 'financial crisis' warning suggest potential fiscal tightening or credit event risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge oil/fuel price volatility in energy and transport portfolios
defensive_moves.rationale: Saudi shock, OPEC+ silence, diesel supply down 8% create two-way risk. Avoid directional bets until OPEC+ clarity.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound. Tech and miners provide support; oil volatility, soft PMI, and RBA tightening cap upside. Jetstar industrial action and fuel costs pressure consumer/transport. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow band with sector rotation favouring tech and gold over energy and discretionary.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and PMI stabilises. Structural themes: AI/tech adoption, critical minerals demand from China robotics shift, gold as geopolitical hedge. Fiscal sustainability and El Niño are key downside risks. CGT reform supports property investor sentiment. China property recovery would be a positive catalyst for iron ore.
key_catalysts: RBA next rate decision and statement
OPEC+ production meeting / Saudi policy clarity
CGT and negative gearing legislative progress
El Niño intensity and agricultural impact
Gold assay results (Dalaroo, Platina, Critical Resources)
watch_list: Iron ore, gold, LNG spot prices
RBA cash rate and 10-year bond yield
Australian CPI and retail sales data
Diesel supply and fuel price indices
ASX tech sector relative performance vs Nasdaq
Government fiscal balance and debt-to-GDP trajectory
